about_the_game:
TSW Compatible content released for a previous Train Sim World® - features may remain unchanged from the original release and may not make use of all newer core features.

Return to the rails of Birmingham and tackle the Lickey Incline in diesel traction. From Rivet Games, their Class 170 thrashes into the Midlands for additional Cross-City line services in not just one, but two distinct liveries; West Midlands Railway and CrossCountry!

The Class 170 has been a recognisable part of UK regional and longer-distance services for the past 25 years and continues to be a staple for connecting towns and cities that do not feature wholly electrified railways. Across multiple variants and fleet shuffles, they have taken on many roles and paint schemes over the past few decades.

Originally part of Rivet Games’ Fife Circle Line as the ScotRail Class 170/4, the iconic turbo now stars in a new role, filling out and enhancing the Cross-City Line. Including both the 170/5 and 170/6 subclasses, with detail changes such as original headlights, updated cabs and interiors, the Class 170 is now presented in West Midlands Railway livery, as well as the far-reaching CrossCountry livery!

In Train Sim World, step into the cab of the Class 170 and take on new Cross-City challenges. Operate both WMR & XC services between Birmingham New St and Bromsgrove, calling only at University, and overtaking Class 323 traffic. Patiently power up the famed Lickey Incline, it’s no small feat with diesel-powered stock! Layers make the route feel as busy as England’s second city should be, and the XC livery is perfect for roaming around the UK!

Please Note: For the full experience, we recommend you own Train Sim World®: Birmingham Cross-City Line which is available as a separate purchase.

Key Features


  • BR Class 170/5 (2-car) and 170/6 (3-car) DMUs in two liveries;
    • West Midlands Railway (WMR)
    • CrossCountry (XC)
    • Original Adtranz-style headlight clusters
    • Livery-specifc cabs and passenger interior layouts
  • Highly detailed, feature-rich, driving cabs
  • True-to-life performance, suspension and handling
  • Accessible Tutorials on the Training Center
  • 3x scenarios for Birmingham Cross-City Line
  • An enhanced version of the Cross-City Line 2019 timetable (layered content available separately)
    • New WMR & XC Class 170 services between Bromsgrove & Birmingham New St
    • New WMR & Class 350 (layered) services between Birmingham New St & Aston
    • Layered Class 350 & Avanti West Coast Pendolino AI at Birmingham New St & Lichfield Trent Valley
    • Transport for Wales AI at Birmingham New St
    • Conductor Mode functionality
  • Livery Designer, Formation Designer and Scenario Planner compatible. Share your creations with the Creators Club
  • Powered by Dovetail Games’ proprietary SimuGraph® vehicle dynamics engine and Unreal Engine 4® technology
  • Download size: 294.7 MB
